description: NirnayDAG Phase 2A decision-record corpus benchmark registry
licenseNotice: All repositories listed are publicly hosted open-source projects analyzed under their respective open-source licenses for evaluation and research purposes. NirnayDAG benchmarks local clones and does not redistribute repository contents.

repositories.name: adr/madr
repositories.description: Markdown Architectural Decision Records specification decisions

repositories.name: rust-lang/rfcs
repositories.description: Rust RFC (Request for Comments) decision documents

repositories.name: kubernetes/enhancements
repositories.description: Kubernetes Enhancement Proposals (KEPs) across SIG working groups

repositories.name: JabRef/jabref

evaluatedAndDropped.name: python/peps
evaluatedAndDropped.reason: PEPs in python/peps are authored in reStructuredText (.rst) format (e.g. pep-0008.rst), not Markdown (.md or .mdx). NirnayDAG is designed for Markdown-based decision records and cannot parse .rst files without format changes.

evaluatedAndDropped.name: joelparkerhenderson/architecture-decision-record
evaluatedAndDropped.reason: This repository is an educational compilation and template directory containing over 35,000 localized translation files and guides rather than an active engineering project's architectural decision record DAG.
